parameters.name: DateType
parameters.description: Time filter type, supports filtering by the last 7 days, the last 30 days, the last half year, or custom time periods.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mssp get-baseline-summary --date-type month --start-date 1729478485000 --end-date 1732156885986 --susp-event-source '该字段暂未使用，有问题请联系管理员' --region cn-hangzhou
